description: Creates an isolated private network in your account and returns its id, name and address range. It has its own router with an internet connection and no route to your other private networks, so a job's machines on it are kept apart from the rest of your account. Pass the id as network_id to create_instance or to the managed database tools. It is billed hourly while it exists and counts toward your account's network limit. Remove it with delete_private_network when the job is done.

cidr.description: Optional address range for the new network, e.g. 10.20.0.0/24. Omit it and redu picks the next free range. It must not overlap a range your account already uses.

run_id.description: Optional: the id of a run (from create_run). The new resource joins that run, and end_run deletes it with the rest of the run.

name: create_private_network
title: Create private network
